Introducing the next chapter in A1's journey. Experience effortless, hands-free filming that captures every angle with the Follow Me Bundle, precisely place every frame where it belongs with the Remote Controller, and take your explorations further with the Cellular Module. 
 
Follow Me Bundle
✅ Watch & Ring Remotes put flight controls right on your wrist. No complex setups needed
✅ GPS-Powered Tracking keeps you in frame even through momentary obstructions
✅ Get it all in a single flight. 360 Capture gets every angle, landmark, and laugh on the first try
✅ New Full-Coverage Propeller Guards with Omnidirectional Obstacle Avoidance keep your flights protected in complex environments
✅ Use ready-to-go Sky Genie templates to create unforgettable memories
Remote Controller
✅ Traditional layout, precision controls. Responsive flight right at your fingertips
✅ New Fixed View aligns the view with the drone's heading for precise framing
